author: jmpx448
name: nfc-wifi
display_name: Wi-Fi from an NFC tag or QR code
description: Touching an NFC tag with a Wi-Fi network, or reading a Wi-Fi QR code with the Camera, asks whether to connect and adds the network. Loads the sfos-nfc-wifi handler in the home screen and adds a Connect to Wi-Fi button to the Camera's QR code page, which hides the password. Needs the sfos-nfc-wifi package.
